title: Timed shot choreography
when_to_use: Use when a Seedance video task requires timed shot choreography; this candidate is for explicit inspection only.
method: For a multi-beat clip, draft a global look and immutable subjects, then partition the complete duration into adjacent intervals. Assign each interval one visible action, camera placement/movement, sound cue and an end-state inherited by the next interval. Validate intervals cover runtime exactly.
failure_modes: multiple competing actions in one interval
verification: Candidate; no real Seedance output validation. Do not auto-activate.
